items.title_en: Merz Hosts Nvidia's Huang in Berlin to Boost German AI Investments
items.title_zh: 默茨在柏林会见英伟达黄仁勋，推动德国 AI 投资
items.hook_en: In Berlin, Chancellor Friedrich Merz sat down with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, urging Germany to lead in industrial AI by blending its engineering prowess with cutting-edge tech.
items.hook_zh: 德国总理弗里德里希·默茨与英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋会面，呼吁以工程实力引领工业 AI。
items.summary_en: At the Invest in Germany Summit on October 19, Merz welcomed global investors and discussed AI regulation with Huang, who stressed that thriving industry must come before rules, with safety rooted in engineering and best practices. Nvidia announced investments in four German startups—Agile Robots, Avelios Medical, Mirelo, and Reflex Aerospace—as part of its $10 billion European commitment, and signed a deal with the government for advanced physical AI models using German industrial data. Huang praised Germany's irreplaceable engineering, noting Nvidia's 1,000 local employees and nearly $1 billion invested last year, while Merz highlighted the nation's strong industrial base and market access to shape its economic future.
items.summary_zh: 在 10 月 19 日“投资德国峰会”上，默茨与黄仁勋讨论 AI 监管；黄仁勋强调产业繁荣应先于规则，安全植根于工程与最佳实践。英伟达宣布投资 Agile Robots、Avelios Medical、Mirelo、Reflex Aerospace 四家德国初创，并纳入其 100 亿美元欧洲承诺，同时与德国政府就基于本土工业数据的物理 AI 模型达成合作。黄仁勋称赞德国工程不可替代，并提到英伟达在当地约有 1000 名员工、去年投资近 10 亿美元。
items.body_en:
Merz Hosts Nvidia's Huang in Berlin to Boost German AI Investments.

In Berlin, Chancellor Friedrich Merz sat down with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, urging Germany to lead in industrial AI by blending its engineering prowess with cutting-edge tech.

At the Invest in Germany Summit on October 19, Merz welcomed global investors and discussed AI regulation with Huang, who stressed that thriving industry must come before rules, with safety rooted in engineering and best practices.

Nvidia announced investments in four German startups—Agile Robots, Avelios Medical, Mirelo, and Reflex Aerospace—as part of its $10 billion European commitment, and signed a deal with the government for advanced physical AI models using German industrial data. Huang praised Germany's irreplaceable engineering, noting Nvidia's 1,000 local employees and nearly $1 billion invested last year, while Merz highlighted the nation's strong industrial base and market access to shape its economic future.
items.body_zh:
默茨在柏林会见英伟达黄仁勋，推动德国 AI 投资。

德国总理弗里德里希·默茨与英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋会面，呼吁以工程实力引领工业 AI。

在 10 月 19 日“投资德国峰会”上，默茨与黄仁勋讨论 AI 监管；黄仁勋强调产业繁荣应先于规则，安全植根于工程与最佳实践。

英伟达宣布投资 Agile Robots、Avelios Medical、Mirelo、Reflex Aerospace 四家德国初创，并纳入其 100 亿美元欧洲承诺，同时与德国政府就基于本土工业数据的物理 AI 模型达成合作。黄仁勋称赞德国工程不可替代，并提到英伟达在当地约有 1000 名员工、去年投资近 10 亿美元。

items.title_en: Sam Altman Outlines Three Paths for Safe Advanced AI Development
items.title_zh: 奥特曼勾勒先进 AI 安全发展的三条路径
items.hook_en: Sam Altman gathered OpenAI staff to map out three stark options for handling super-smart AI, right as the Trump administration steps in with its own oversight plans.
items.hook_zh: 萨姆·奥特曼召集 OpenAI 员工讨论应对超强 AI 的三条截然不同选项，恰逢特朗普政府推出自有监管计划。
items.summary_en: Last week, Altman described an international body like the IAEA to enforce safety at frontier labs, which he favors; a CERN-style merger of AI labs to share models, known as the 'Demis plan'; and a rejected idea of one lab dominating by disabling rivals' hardware, dubbed the 'Eliezer plan.' He stressed OpenAI must pick a path within a year to avoid falling behind competitors amid safety pressures. The talk coincides with the Trump administration's new Super Intelligence Force, using existing laws to tackle national security and civil liberties risks from advanced AI. Reports from The Information have sparked online talks on AI's future, blending safety concerns with hopes for shared prosperity.
items.summary_zh: 上周奥特曼描述了三条路径：他倾向的类似国际原子能机构的国际机构以约束前沿实验室安全；被称为「Demis 方案」的类 CERN 实验室合并以共享模型；以及被否决的「Eliezer 方案」——由单一实验室通过瘫痪对手硬件来主导。他强调 OpenAI 须在一年内选定路径，以免在安全压力下落后于竞争对手。谈话正值特朗普政府成立「超级智能部队」，拟用现有法律应对先进 AI 带来的国家安全与公民自由风险。《The Information》相关报道引发网上对 AI 未来的讨论，交织安全关切与共享繁荣期待。
items.body_en:
Sam Altman Outlines Three Paths for Safe Advanced AI Development.

Sam Altman gathered OpenAI staff to map out three stark options for handling super-smart AI, right as the Trump administration steps in with its own oversight plans.

Last week, Altman described an international body like the IAEA to enforce safety at frontier labs, which he favors; a CERN-style merger of AI labs to share models, known as the 'Demis plan'; and a rejected idea of one lab dominating by disabling rivals' hardware, dubbed the 'Eliezer plan.' He stressed OpenAI must pick a path within a year to avoid falling behind competitors amid safety pressures.

The talk coincides with the Trump administration's new Super Intelligence Force, using existing laws to tackle national security and civil liberties risks from advanced AI. Reports from The Information have sparked online talks on AI's future, blending safety concerns with hopes for shared prosperity.
items.body_zh:
奥特曼勾勒先进 AI 安全发展的三条路径。

萨姆·奥特曼召集 OpenAI 员工讨论应对超强 AI 的三条截然不同选项，恰逢特朗普政府推出自有监管计划。

上周奥特曼描述了三条路径：他倾向的类似国际原子能机构的国际机构以约束前沿实验室安全；被称为「Demis 方案」的类 CERN 实验室合并以共享模型；以及被否决的「Eliezer 方案」——由单一实验室通过瘫痪对手硬件来主导。他强调 OpenAI 须在一年内选定路径，以免在安全压力下落后于竞争对手。

谈话正值特朗普政府成立「超级智能部队」，拟用现有法律应对先进 AI 带来的国家安全与公民自由风险。《The Information》相关报道引发网上对 AI 未来的讨论，交织安全关切与共享繁荣期待。

items.title_en: DHS Orders Federal Agencies to Remove DeepSeek AI Products
items.title_zh: 美国土安全部要求民事机构清除 DeepSeek 产品
items.hook_en: Federal agencies now face a clear directive: pull DeepSeek's Chinese AI tools from their systems to guard against data risks heading to China.
items.hook_zh: 联邦民事机构接到明确指令：因涉华安全风险，须从系统中移除相关中国 AI 工具。
items.summary_en: The U.S. Department of Homeland Security issued an order on October 20 requiring civilian federal agencies to remove DeepSeek products from IT systems and halt future purchases under the Federal Acquisition Supply Chain Security Act. The move addresses threats like sensitive data transfers to China, potential intelligence generation on U.S. persons, and malware risks in the models. This builds on prior limits by some agencies and states, applying broadly to civilian executive branch systems while sparing defense networks. Reactions split, with supporters praising network protection and critics noting the model's open-source nature could spur local alternatives.
items.summary_zh: 美国国土安全部于 10 月 20 日下令，要求联邦民事机构从 IT 系统中移除所有 DeepSeek 产品、关联方及相关第三方服务，并停止后续采购。关切包括公司总部位于中国、数据可能移交中国当局、收集个人信息，以及对美国人实施恶意软件或情报搜集的风险。此举凸显美中 AI 博弈；DeepSeek 最新 V4.1 因在日常硬件上的速度与效率仍受关注。命令仅适用于民事机构，可有例外。
items.body_en:
DHS Orders Federal Agencies to Remove DeepSeek AI Products.

Federal agencies now face a clear directive: pull DeepSeek's Chinese AI tools from their systems to guard against data risks heading to China.

The U.S. Department of Homeland Security issued an order on October 20 requiring civilian federal agencies to remove DeepSeek products from IT systems and halt future purchases under the Federal Acquisition Supply Chain Security Act. The move addresses threats like sensitive data transfers to China, potential intelligence generation on U.S.

persons, and malware risks in the models. This builds on prior limits by some agencies and states, applying broadly to civilian executive branch systems while sparing defense networks. Reactions split, with supporters praising network protection and critics noting the model's open-source nature could spur local alternatives.

items.title_en: Anthropic Commits Shares to Public Benefit Fund
items.title_zh: Anthropic 将股份拨入公益基金
items.hook_en: Anthropic's pledge to dedicate 5% of its shares to public good initiatives feels like a direct response to AI's promise of abundance for everyone.
items.hook_zh: Anthropic 承诺拿出 5% 股份用于公益，被视作对 AI「丰裕」承诺的回应。
items.summary_en: The AI company behind Claude models announced a Public Benefit Fund starting with 5% of shares, pending stockholder approval, which could grow by up to 2% for every 50% valuation increase above a baseline. Combined with prior pledges, this totals about 20% of shares for purposes like nonprofit donations, aid to affected groups, or addressing AI's job impacts—building on a $200 million labor study commitment, with no funds for lobbying. Elon Musk replied that this is what he will do, later specifying 'universal high income,' fueling talk of AI-driven prosperity shared widely, though some see it as flexible public benefit rather than formal income programs.
items.summary_zh: 公益基金起步拟配置 5% 股份（待批准）；叠加此前承诺，约 20% 股份将用于非营利捐赠与就业冲击援助。
items.body_en:
Anthropic Commits Shares to Public Benefit Fund.

Anthropic's pledge to dedicate 5% of its shares to public good initiatives feels like a direct response to AI's promise of abundance for everyone.

The AI company behind Claude models announced a Public Benefit Fund starting with 5% of shares, pending stockholder approval, which could grow by up to 2% for every 50% valuation increase above a baseline.

Combined with prior pledges, this totals about 20% of shares for purposes like nonprofit donations, aid to affected groups, or addressing AI's job impacts—building on a $200 million labor study commitment, with no funds for lobbying. Elon Musk replied that this is what he will do, later specifying 'universal high income,' fueling talk of AI-driven prosperity shared widely, though some see it as flexible public benefit rather than formal income programs.
items.body_zh:

Anthropic 承诺拿出 5% 股份用于公益，被视作对 AI「丰裕」承诺的回应。

公益基金起步拟配置 5% 股份（待批准）；叠加此前承诺，约 20% 股份将用于非营利捐赠与就业冲击援助。

items.title_en: OpenAI Launches Locked Chats for Private ChatGPT Conversations
items.title_zh: OpenAI 推出「锁定对话」，保护私密 ChatGPT 聊天
items.hook_en: Ever had a ChatGPT chat too personal to leave in plain view? OpenAI's new Locked Chats let you tuck it away, protected by a PIN or your fingerprint.
items.hook_zh: 把屏幕递给别人前，想先藏起敏感对话？锁定对话用 PIN 就能搞定。
items.summary_en: The feature hides selected chats from history, pins, and searches, making them accessible only through a four-digit PIN on all platforms or biometrics on supported phones. It rolled out starting October 20 across Free, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, and Edu plans on web, desktop, and mobile. Locked chats keep new messages in a separate memory section without affecting regular ones, though they lack end-to-end encryption and can't be recovered if the PIN is reset. This adds device-level privacy amid discussions on ChatGPT's memory system, where a study found most entries include psychological insights or personal data created automatically.
items.summary_zh: 用户可将聊天移入受保护区域，需 PIN、Face ID 或 Touch ID 解锁才可见；功能将覆盖免费到企业版各档套餐。
items.body_en:
OpenAI Launches Locked Chats for Private ChatGPT Conversations.

Ever had a ChatGPT chat too personal to leave in plain view? OpenAI's new Locked Chats let you tuck it away, protected by a PIN or your fingerprint.

The feature hides selected chats from history, pins, and searches, making them accessible only through a four-digit PIN on all platforms or biometrics on supported phones. It rolled out starting October 20 across Free, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, and Edu plans on web, desktop, and mobile.

Locked chats keep new messages in a separate memory section without affecting regular ones, though they lack end-to-end encryption and can't be recovered if the PIN is reset. This adds device-level privacy amid discussions on ChatGPT's memory system, where a study found most entries include psychological insights or personal data created automatically.
items.body_zh:
OpenAI 推出「锁定对话」，保护私密 ChatGPT 聊天。

把屏幕递给别人前，想先藏起敏感对话？锁定对话用 PIN 就能搞定。

用户可将聊天移入受保护区域，需 PIN、Face ID 或 Touch ID 解锁才可见；功能将覆盖免费到企业版各档套餐。

综合以上信息，OpenAI 推出「锁定对话」，保护私密 ChatGPT 聊天一事持续引发关注。

items.title_en: Viggle JST-2 and Dream Labs Dream-1 Launch Fast AI Tools for 3D and Robots
items.title_zh: Viggle JST-2 与 Dream Labs Dream-1 推出快速 3D 与机器人 AI 工具
items.hook_en: Imagine generating a full 3D world in one second for under a penny, or powering robots you've never seen before at just $3 an hour. Two new AI models make these feats real this week.
items.hook_zh: 一秒生成完整三维世界、成本不到一美分，或是用每小时约 3 美元驱动从未见过的机器人——两款新模型本周让这些场景成真。
items.summary_en: Viggle released JST-2, the first full-stack physics-native world foundation model that builds 3D scenes from scratch in about one second for less than a cent, allowing real-time expansion from any angle with characters and motion from text or video. Dream Labs debuted Dream-1 from stealth, a robot foundation model backed by a $90 million seed round, which controls unfamiliar bimanual robots on new tasks via a public API starting at $3 per hour. Early testers praised quick successes like playground tasks on rover arms, though finer precision needs work, pointing to lower barriers for creators in simulations, games, and robotics.
items.summary_zh: Viggle 发布 JST-2，号称首个全栈、物理原生的世界基础模型，可在约一秒内从零构建三维场景，成本不足一美分，并能从任意角度实时扩展，用文本或视频加入角色与动作。Dream Labs 则从隐身状态亮相 Dream-1，这是一款机器人基础模型，获 9000 万美元种子轮支持，可通过公开 API 以每小时约 3 美元起控制陌生双臂机器人完成新任务。早期测试者称在漫游车机械臂上能较快完成场地任务，但精细精度仍待提升，整体降低了仿真、游戏与机器人创作者的门槛。
items.body_en:
Viggle JST-2 and Dream Labs Dream-1 Launch Fast AI Tools for 3D and Robots.

Imagine generating a full 3D world in one second for under a penny, or powering robots you've never seen before at just $3 an hour. Two new AI models make these feats real this week.

Viggle released JST-2, the first full-stack physics-native world foundation model that builds 3D scenes from scratch in about one second for less than a cent, allowing real-time expansion from any angle with characters and motion from text or video.

Dream Labs debuted Dream-1 from stealth, a robot foundation model backed by a $90 million seed round, which controls unfamiliar bimanual robots on new tasks via a public API starting at $3 per hour. Early testers praised quick successes like playground tasks on rover arms, though finer precision needs work, pointing to lower barriers for creators in simulations, games, and robotics.

items.title_en: OpenAI Quiets Support for AI Chip Export Limits to China
items.title_zh: OpenAI 对限制对华出口 AI 芯片的立场明显降温
items.hook_en: OpenAI once pushed hard for strict U.S. limits on advanced AI chips heading to China. Now, the company has gone quiet, leaving policymakers surprised and critics pointing fingers.
items.hook_zh: OpenAI 曾大力推动美国严格限制先进 AI 芯片输往中国，如今却基本不再发声。
items.summary_en: Last year, OpenAI lobbied for curbs on sales of Nvidia's advanced processors to Beijing-backed AI labs to protect U.S. interests. Capitol Hill aides note the firm has stopped advocating, a shift that aids Nvidia—which opposes tighter rules—and aligns with broader political approaches amid a major 2025 infrastructure partnership worth up to $100 billion. Critics like Samuel Hammond call it shortsighted for U.S. AI dominance and security, while OpenAI stresses maintaining a compute lead through effective controls as part of strategy. Rival Anthropic continues backing restriction bills as lawmakers eye defense bill amendments.
items.summary_zh: 去年 OpenAI 曾游说限制英伟达处理器流向有北京背景的实验室；知情人士称公司已停止相关倡议。这一转向有利于英伟达，也与其 2025 年一项重大基础设施合作相呼应。
items.body_en:
OpenAI Quiets Support for AI Chip Export Limits to China.

OpenAI once pushed hard for strict U.S. limits on advanced AI chips heading to China. Now, the company has gone quiet, leaving policymakers surprised and critics pointing fingers.

Last year, OpenAI lobbied for curbs on sales of Nvidia's advanced processors to Beijing-backed AI labs to protect U.S. interests. Capitol Hill aides note the firm has stopped advocating, a shift that aids Nvidia—which opposes tighter rules—and aligns with broader political approaches amid a major 2025 infrastructure partnership worth up to $100 billion.

Critics like Samuel Hammond call it shortsighted for U.S. AI dominance and security, while OpenAI stresses maintaining a compute lead through effective controls as part of strategy. Rival Anthropic continues backing restriction bills as lawmakers eye defense bill amendments.

综合以上信息，OpenAI 对限制对华出口 AI 芯片的立场明显降温一事持续引发关注。

items.title_en: Amazon Explores Offloading $8 Billion in Nvidia Chips to Investors
items.title_zh: 亚马逊探讨向投资者转移约 80 亿美元英伟达芯片
items.hook_en: Amazon has thousands of cutting-edge Nvidia chips ready for its U.S. data centers, but power shortages mean many sit unused in warehouses.
items.hook_zh: 大量先进英伟达芯片已备好进美国数据中心，却因电力不足堆在仓库。
items.summary_en: The company is in talks to shift about $8 billion worth of Grace Blackwell chips into a special-purpose vehicle, which would lease them back to Amazon and raise funds through debt and a small equity stake. This comes as internal documents reveal a massive influx of Nvidia GB300 racks—$5 billion in one month alone—piling up due to insufficient power and infrastructure in data centers across Nevada and Virginia. Observers note the timing raises questions about Amazon's AI hardware glut amid its $220 billion capital spending push, though some see the move as smart financing to keep using the chips without owning them outright.
items.summary_zh: 公司正洽谈将约 80 亿美元 Grace Blackwell 芯片装入特殊目的载体，再回租给亚马逊，并以债务与少量股权融资。内部文件显示英伟达 GB300 机架大量涌入——单月即约 50 亿美元——因内华达与弗吉尼亚等地电力与基础设施不足而积压。有人质疑其在约 2200 亿美元资本开支背景下的算力过剩，也有人视之为「用而不必全资持有」的融资安排。
items.body_en:
Amazon Explores Offloading $8 Billion in Nvidia Chips to Investors.

Amazon has thousands of cutting-edge Nvidia chips ready for its U.S. data centers, but power shortages mean many sit unused in warehouses.

The company is in talks to shift about $8 billion worth of Grace Blackwell chips into a special-purpose vehicle, which would lease them back to Amazon and raise funds through debt and a small equity stake.

This comes as internal documents reveal a massive influx of Nvidia GB300 racks—$5 billion in one month alone—piling up due to insufficient power and infrastructure in data centers across Nevada and Virginia. Observers note the timing raises questions about Amazon's AI hardware glut amid its $220 billion capital spending push, though some see the move as smart financing to keep using the chips without owning them outright.
items.body_zh:

公司正洽谈将约 80 亿美元 Grace Blackwell 芯片装入特殊目的载体，再回租给亚马逊，并以债务与少量股权融资。内部文件显示英伟达 GB300 机架大量涌入——单月即约 50 亿美元——因内华达与弗吉尼亚等地电力与基础设施不足而积压。

有人质疑其在约 2200 亿美元资本开支背景下的算力过剩，也有人视之为「用而不必全资持有」的融资安排。

items.title_en: Nvidia in Talks for Hundreds of Millions Investment in Firmus After Scrapped IPO
items.title_zh: Nvidia 洽谈向 Firmus 注资数亿美元，Firmus 已搁置 IPO
items.hook_en: Firmus had its sights set on a massive IPO, but pulled back amid market jitters. Now Nvidia, already a partner, is stepping up with talks of a huge cash infusion.

items.body_en:
Nvidia in Talks for Hundreds of Millions Investment in Firmus After Scrapped IPO.

Firmus had its sights set on a massive IPO, but pulled back amid market jitters. Now Nvidia, already a partner, is stepping up with talks of a huge cash infusion.

Australian AI cloud provider Firmus abandoned its planned blockbuster IPO on the Australian Securities Exchange earlier this month due to investor concerns over high valuations and its short track record. Nvidia, which already invests in Firmus and partners on a major GPU deployment in Indonesia's Batam campus, is now discussing an equity investment of several hundred million dollars—possibly at least AU$500 million.

This move aligns with Nvidia's strategy to back neocloud operators amid surging AI computing demand, as Firmus pivots to private funding up to US$3 billion. No final deal details are confirmed yet.

items.title_en: OpenAI Acquires Orchestra Bio to Speed Drug Development
items.title_zh: OpenAI 收购 Orchestra Bio，加速药物研发
items.hook_en: OpenAI just brought in a team that's been streamlining drug development for four years, right on the startup's anniversary.
items.hook_zh: 创业四周年那天，Ashoka Rajendra 得知 OpenAI 将把团队收入麾下。
items.summary_en: On October 20, 2026, OpenAI announced its acquisition of Orchestra Bio, a four-year-old platform that coordinates biopharma teams on tasks like monitoring studies and flagging delays. The deal merges Orchestra's technology with OpenAI's Rosalind AI tools to help scientists link discoveries to treatments faster, using agents that handle operational workflows. OpenAI President Greg Brockman called it an exciting step toward accelerating medicines, while founder Ashoka Rajendra noted AI's growing role in teaming up with people. This move aligns with rivals like Anthropic entering life sciences.

items.body_en:
OpenAI Acquires Orchestra Bio to Speed Drug Development.

Imagine AI agents spotting a failed drug batch and instantly suggesting fixes to keep treatments on track for patients.

OpenAI acquired Orchestra Bio, a four-year-old startup founded by Ashoka Rajendra, to integrate its platform with Rosalind AI tools for life sciences. The deal equips biopharma teams with agents that monitor studies, track timelines, flag delays, and coordinate across partners, aiming to turn scientific discoveries into patient treatments faster.

It builds on OpenAI's work with customers like Moderna and Novo Nordisk, amid a trend of AI labs entering biotech. Investors and leaders like Greg Brockman expressed excitement about accelerating the 10-15 year drug development process.

items.title_en: Microsoft Pulls Out of UK's Largest Planned AI Data Center Over Power Shortage

items.hook_en: Microsoft backed away from a massive AI supercomputer project in Essex after learning grid power won't arrive until the 2030s. The move spotlights Britain's struggle to fuel its AI dreams with reliable electricity.

UK Power Networks cited decade-long delays, prompting Microsoft to terminate just for this site while keeping ties with Nscale strong. Nscale presses on with alternative power and other locations, amid talk of grid bottlenecks holding back the UK's third-place global AI ranking. Observers debate fixes like faster permits and targeted grid investments to match policy ambition with infrastructure reality.

items.body_en:
California Wealth Tax Faces Backlash as Billionaires Exit State.

Dozens of California's billionaires, including Larry Page, Sergey Brin, and Peter Thiel, have left ahead of a key residency deadline, dodging a proposed 5% wealth tax.

items.title_en: NVIDIA Runs Record 104-Qubit Quantum Simulation on JUPITER Supercomputer
items.title_zh: 英伟达在 JUPITER 超算上完成创纪录 104 量子比特模拟
items.hook_en: NVIDIA researchers pushed classical computing to mimic a fault-tolerant quantum system with 104 qubits—the largest simulation yet—using thousands of GPUs in Germany.
items.hook_zh: 英伟达研究人员用德国数千块 GPU，推动经典计算模拟容错量子系统，达 104 量子比特——迄今最大规模。
items.summary_en: On Europe’s JUPITER supercomputer at the Jülich Supercomputing Centre, NVIDIA simulated a 104-qubit fault-tolerant quantum processor with 8,192 GH200 GPUs, including realistic hardware noise that past efforts overlooked. The simulation validated magic state cultivation, a method that slashes physical qubit needs by about 90 percent, guiding error mitigation for drug discovery, financial modeling, and materials science. CEO Jensen Huang highlighted how such digital twins of factories will let workers design AI cars and robotic plants virtually first. This bridges GPU simulations with real quantum hardware, de-risking development and speeding practical machines.
items.summary_zh: 在于利希超算中心的欧洲 JUPITER 超算上，英伟达用 8192 块 GH200 GPU 模拟了 104 量子比特容错量子处理器，并纳入以往常被忽略的真实硬件噪声。模拟验证了「魔法态培育」方法，可将物理量子比特需求削减约 90%，为药物发现、金融建模与材料科学的误差缓解提供指引。CEO 黄仁勋强调，此类工厂数字孪生可让工人先虚拟设计 AI 汽车与机器人产线。此举衔接 GPU 模拟与真实量子硬件，降低开发风险并加速实用化。
items.body_en:
NVIDIA Runs Record 104-Qubit Quantum Simulation on JUPITER Supercomputer.

NVIDIA researchers pushed classical computing to mimic a fault-tolerant quantum system with 104 qubits—the largest simulation yet—using thousands of GPUs in Germany.

On Europe’s JUPITER supercomputer at the Jülich Supercomputing Centre, NVIDIA simulated a 104-qubit fault-tolerant quantum processor with 8,192 GH200 GPUs, including realistic hardware noise that past efforts overlooked. The simulation validated magic state cultivation, a method that slashes physical qubit needs by about 90 percent, guiding error mitigation for drug discovery, financial modeling, and materials science.

CEO Jensen Huang highlighted how such digital twins of factories will let workers design AI cars and robotic plants virtually first. This bridges GPU simulations with real quantum hardware, de-risking development and speeding practical machines.

在于利希超算中心的欧洲 JUPITER 超算上，英伟达用 8192 块 GH200 GPU 模拟了 104 量子比特容错量子处理器，并纳入以往常被忽略的真实硬件噪声。模拟验证了「魔法态培育」方法，可将物理量子比特需求削减约 90%，为药物发现、金融建模与材料科学的误差缓解提供指引。

SoftBank recently sealed the largest corporate junk-bond offering on record, raising over $11 billion for AI investments amid a surge in new markets for compute and predictions. Observers celebrated this resilience as proof of America's unmatched capital markets strength, with comments hailing its bottomless appetite for innovation and ability to sideline setbacks.

items.title_en: Former Finance Secretary Sparks Debate on India's GDP in Dollar Terms
items.title_zh: 前财秘以美元口径 GDP 数据引发印度增长辩论
items.hook_en: Subhash Chandra Garg, ex-Finance Secretary, shared IMF data showing India's GDP growth in current US dollars at just 3.87%—well below the world average and China's rate—prompting a lively back-and-forth online.
items.hook_zh: 前财政秘书苏巴什·钱德拉·加尔格分享 IMF 数据称，印度按现价美元计 GDP 增速仅 3.87%，低于全球均值与中国，引发网上热议。
items.summary_en: Garg contrasted this with India's real GDP growth of around 7% in local terms, arguing the dollar measure gives a fuller picture often missed in domestic talks. Critics say focusing on dollars mixes in currency fluctuations and overlooks actual output, while supporters like Sanjay Jha tie it to investor outflows exceeding Rs 3 lakh crore from Indian stocks in 2026 and job concerns. The IMF's October 2026 outlook projects India's real growth at 7%, but nominal dollar GDP lags partly due to rupee depreciation, highlighting tensions between real output metrics and global investor views.
items.summary_zh: 加尔格将其与印度本币实际 GDP 约 7% 的增速对照，认为美元口径更能呈现国内讨论常忽略的全貌。批评者称盯住美元会混入汇率波动、忽视实际产出；支持者如 Sanjay Jha 则将其与 2026 年印度股市外资流出逾 3 万亿卢比及就业担忧挂钩。IMF 2026 年 10 月展望仍预计印度实际增速 7%，但名义美元 GDP 因卢比贬值等因素滞后，凸显产出指标与全球投资者视角之间的张力。

Former Finance Secretary Sparks Debate on India's GDP in Dollar Terms.

Subhash Chandra Garg, ex-Finance Secretary, shared IMF data showing India's GDP growth in current US dollars at just 3.87%—well below the world average and China's rate—prompting a lively back-and-forth online.

Garg contrasted this with India's real GDP growth of around 7% in local terms, arguing the dollar measure gives a fuller picture often missed in domestic talks.

Critics say focusing on dollars mixes in currency fluctuations and overlooks actual output, while supporters like Sanjay Jha tie it to investor outflows exceeding Rs 3 lakh crore from Indian stocks in 2026 and job concerns. The IMF's October 2026 outlook projects India's real growth at 7%, but nominal dollar GDP lags partly due to rupee depreciation, highlighting tensions between real output metrics and global investor views.

加尔格将其与印度本币实际 GDP 约 7% 的增速对照，认为美元口径更能呈现国内讨论常忽略的全貌。批评者称盯住美元会混入汇率波动、忽视实际产出；支持者如 Sanjay Jha 则将其与 2026 年印度股市外资流出逾 3 万亿卢比及就业担忧挂钩。

Fed's $1.827 Billion Treasury Purchase Lifts Stocks and Crypto.

US stocks and cryptocurrencies climbed Tuesday after the Federal Reserve bought $1.827 billion in Treasury bills, settling the same day and fueling trader excitement.

The New York Fed's October 19 operation accepted $1.827 billion in 4-to-12-month Treasury bills, with settlement on October 20 as part of its regular secondary-market purchases to maintain banking reserves.

Bitcoin rose about 1.35% to near $82,952, while the S&P 500 gained 0.65% to around 7,741, prompting posts calling the move 'massive' and bullish for risk assets. Traders highlighted the liquidity injection ahead of more scheduled purchases through November, though some noted it mostly replaces maturing holdings rather than expanding the balance sheet.

纽约联储 10 月 19 日操作接受约 18.27 亿美元、期限 4 至 12 个月的国债，于 10 月 20 日结算，属维持银行准备金的常规二级市场买入。比特币涨约 1.35% 至近 82952 美元，标普 500 涨约 0.65% 至约 7741 点，有帖文称操作为「大规模」且利好风险资产。

交易员关注 11 月前更多既定买入带来的流动性，但也有人指出其主要是替换到期持仓，并非扩张资产负债表。

items.body_en:
Nigeria's Central Bank Reforms Steady Economy Amid Trade-offs.

Economist John Olanipekun from Osun State breaks down how Nigeria's central bank turned tough reforms into real gains for everyday people.

Since 2023, Nigeria ended petrol subsidies, freed its foreign-exchange market, and stopped central bank deficit financing, sparking higher inflation over 30 percent and a weaker naira.

The Central Bank raised its policy rate sharply to 27.5 percent and kept cash reserves at 45 percent, bringing inflation down to 15.4 percent, reserves above $50 billion, a steadier currency, and growth near 4 percent. Olanipekun explains that central banks shape bread prices, bus fares, and job chances through tools like interest rates, balancing stable prices against credit and employment risks—no easy choices.

奥孙州经济学家约翰·奥拉尼佩昆拆解尼日利亚央行如何把艰难改革转化为普通人可感的收获。

自 2023 年起，尼日利亚取消燃油补贴、放开外汇市场并停止央行赤字融资，一度推高通胀逾 30%、奈拉走弱。

央行将政策利率大幅提至 27.5%，并维持 45% 现金准备金，使通胀回落至 15.4%，外汇储备逾 500 亿美元，汇率更稳，增长约 4%。奥拉尼佩昆指出，央行通过利率等工具影响面包价格、公交票价与就业机会，需在物价稳定与信贷、就业风险间权衡——没有轻松选项。

J.P. Morgan Forecasts Bitcoin's Top Long-Term Returns Among Major Assets.

J.P. Morgan has crunched the numbers on Bitcoin for the first time in its 31st annual report, predicting it will outpace stocks, gold, and bonds over the next decade or more.

The bank's base case sees Bitcoin delivering a 10% compound annual return from its late-September 2026 price near $83,000, pointing to about $215,000 after 10 years—beating U.S. large-cap stocks at 7.5% and gold at 5.5%.

While noting Bitcoin's high 55% volatility and excluding it from portfolio models, the inclusion signals traditional finance warming to crypto. Japan Faces Yttrium Shortage, Seeks US Help Against China Curbs.

Japan has just months left before running out of yttrium, a vital metal for jet engines and chips, as Chinese shipments nearly halt.

Yttrium oxide shipments from China to Japan have almost stopped in 2026 after tighter export restrictions, driving outside prices to $1,150 per kilogram from $6 two years ago. The shortage endangers aerospace, autos, electronics, and defense, with a Japanese official warning of world economy risks if ignored.

Videos of these displays have sparked online conversations in places like India, where some contrast it with local public messaging and call for emulating the focus on innovation over commercial noise.

Industrial output rose 5.5% in September, retail sales gained 1.1%, and a $133.5 billion trade surplus provided support, driven by tech exports tied to global AI demand.

Yet the CSI 300 index fell for 10 straight weeks, its worst streak, as domestic demand stayed soft with property woes and weak consumer spending. Economists see the rebound easing stimulus pressure but question its staying power.

Hundreds of thousands marched in France on October 17 over soaring living costs and cuts to education, only for the unrest to fuel sharp online arguments about hidden foreign hands.

items.body_en:
Republican Lawmakers Criticize Trump Waiver of Russia Sanctions.

Congressman Max Miller, representing a district with thousands of Ukrainian Americans, called out the Trump administration for waiving sanctions meant to punish Russia over Ukraine.

Reps. Max Miller of Ohio and Jeff Hurd of Colorado sharply criticized the Trump administration's decision to waive key provisions of the bipartisan Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026, which Congress passed in September to cut Russia's war funding through tariffs and economic measures.

Trump cited national interests like lowering U.S. energy prices and advancing peace talks, but the lawmakers argued it eases pressure on Moscow amid its ongoing attacks on Ukraine without real concessions. The move has sparked mixed reactions, with some praising the critics and others prioritizing domestic issues, highlighting GOP tensions over Ukraine support and energy costs ahead of midterms.

Online Debate Heats Up Over Ukraine's Status as U.S. Ally.

Congresswoman Madeleine Dean called Ukraine a key ally amid Washington's cooling ties with Kyiv. Conservative voices fired back, questioning any formal bond.

The argument centers on whether Ukraine counts as a U.S. ally, with no mutual defense treaty, NATO membership, or Major Non-NATO Ally designation.

Posts clash over history too: Ukraine inherited Soviet nukes in 1991, gave them up under the 1994 Budapest Memorandum for security promises from the U.S., U.K., and Russia—but those pledges didn't stop invasions in 2014 or 2022. Recent tensions spiked in mid-October 2026 when President Trump criticized Zelenskyy, eased Russia sanctions, and pushed for peace, cooling U.S.-Ukraine relations and fueling views of Ukraine as either a vital partner or a non-ally in a pricey proxy war.

UK and Poland Rebuke US Defense Secretary Over Afghanistan Ally Claims.

Pete Hegseth recalled seeing dozens of flags in Kabul but claimed only a handful of nations truly fought alongside Americans. British and Polish leaders quickly pushed back, honoring the lives lost by their troops.

During a speech at the University of Tennessee, US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said few NATO allies contributed meaningfully to combat in Afghanistan, joking that the ISAF patch meant 'I Saw Americans Fighting.' Downing Street responded firmly, noting 457 British deaths—the second-highest after the US—and thousands of families who sacrificed for collective security after the 2001 attacks. Poland's Foreign Minister Radosław Sikorski highlighted 44 Polish soldiers killed in Ghazni province, while records show over 1,100 non-US coalition deaths overall, underscoring the broad sacrifices in the 20-year conflict.

英美波驳斥美防长「阿富汗盟友寥寥」说法。

皮特·赫格塞斯称真正并肩作战的国家寥寥无几，英波领导人反击。

items.title_en: Zelenskyy Warns of Russia's Propaganda Push Across Europe

Social media responses pointed to Britain's £25 billion in aid to Ukraine—including £16 billion in weapons—and framed dissent as legitimate debate over spending rather than manipulation. Trump Warns of NATO Exit, Cites France at Kansas Rally.

Thousands packed an arena in Park City, Kansas, cheering as President Trump warned that Europe’s troubles could force America to pull back from NATO.

At a rally supporting Sen. Roger Marshall ahead of the November 3 midterms, Trump described France as a once-great nation overwhelmed by migrants, jihadists, and communists, urging stronger U.S. borders to avoid a similar fate.

He criticized heavy U.S. spending on NATO and Ukraine aid, saying allies must step up or face withdrawal, and expressed willingness for direct talks with Putin and Xi to end the Ukraine conflict. Protesters briefly interrupted but were quickly drowned out by the supportive crowd, as Trump pushed America First priorities alongside pledges for farmers and the economy.

Zelenskyy Mourns Lives and Childhood Lost in Ukraine War.

In Oslo, Zelenskyy spoke from the heart about children robbed of their childhood and lives slipping away daily from Russian attacks.

On October 20, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy addressed a press conference after meetings with U.S. envoy Steve Witkoff, Norwegian Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Støre, and Finnish President Alexander Stubb.

He affirmed Ukraine is not losing the war but highlighted the heavy toll of lost lives, time, and normal childhoods, urging a quick end to the conflict. Zelenskyy praised his soldiers' strength and expressed hope for help from American and European partners toward peace talks and ceasefires. items.hook_en: Taoiseach Micheál Martin stood firm in the Dáil, insisting Ireland can keep its peacekeeping legacy without UN vetoes from powers like Russia or China.

items.summary_en: The government is advancing legislation to scrap the UN approval requirement from Ireland's Triple Lock process for overseas troop deployments of more than 12 Defence Forces members. Currently, deployments need government nod, Dáil vote, and UN backing; the change would drop the last step due to Security Council gridlock. Supporters like Martin cite a 2024 election mandate to update the system while upholding military neutrality, but opposition parties decry it as a sovereignty sellout, with protests and heated Dáil clashes over limited debate time.
items.summary_zh: 爱尔兰政府推进《国防（修正）法案》，拟废除「三重锁」中的联合国授权要求——目前向海外部署超过 12 名国防军须经政府批准、议会表决与联合国背书。马丁等支持者称可防止俄中等大国否决，保障如黎巴嫩维和等任务，尤其在 2014 年以来联合国僵局下。反对派包括玛丽·卢·麦克唐纳与 Peadar Tóibín 指责此举偏离维和、倒向欧盟军事行动，要求公投；议员挥舞「保卫中立」标语，民间亦有抗议。
items.body_en:
Ireland Debates Reforming Triple Lock on Peacekeeping Deployments.

Taoiseach Micheál Martin fired back in the Dáil: 'How dare you lecture me about Irish neutrality? Russia should not have a veto on Irish participation in peacekeeping.' The exchange captured the chamber's raw tension over neutrality's future.

The Irish government is advancing the Defence (Amendment) Bill to scrap the UN mandate requirement in the Triple Lock, which currently needs government approval, a Dáil vote, and UN backing for deploying over 12 Defence Forces members abroad.

Proponents like Martin argue it prevents vetoes by powers like Russia or China, safeguarding missions such as Ireland's in Lebanon amid UN gridlock since 2014. Opposition leaders, including Mary Lou McDonald and Peadar Tóibín, decry it as a drift from peacekeeping to EU-aligned military action and demand a referendum, with TDs waving 'Save Neutrality' signs amid public protests.

items.hook_en: Larry Smith slipped on wet grass between plays, stood briefly, then collapsed clutching his leg—a shocking moment that sidelined the umpire for good this season.
items.hook_zh: 拉里·史密斯在死球间隙湿草上滑倒，短暂站起后又捂腿倒下——这一幕令他本赛季提前告别。
items.summary_en: During the Houston Texans-Jacksonville Jaguars game at Wembley Stadium, second-year NFL umpire Larry Smith tore his right quadriceps in a non-contact slip early in the first quarter. Trainers from both teams helped him off the field on a cart, and his crew finished with six officials while splitting his duties. A middle school principal from Kansas City, Kansas, in his full-time job, Smith won't return until 2027, prompting the NFL to seek a replacement like swing official Tab Slaughter or Ian Malepeai for referee Shawn Hochuli’s crew. Veteran line judge Carl Johnson knelt by his side, hat off in what looked like a prayer, as fans shared surprised laughs about refs joining the injury list.

items.hook_en: Veteran financier Vallabh Bhanshali bluntly called India's capital gains tax on foreign investors a global outlier that's damaged inflows. As FPIs pull out billions, he's pushing for a full review.
items.hook_zh: 资深金融人士瓦拉布·班沙利直言，印度对外国投资者征收资本利得税在全球少见，已损害资金流入，并呼吁全面检讨。
items.summary_en: In a CNBC-TV18 interview, Enam Group's co-founder Vallabh Bhanshali argued the long-term capital gains tax on foreign institutional investors should be eliminated, noting no other country imposes it this way. FPIs have withdrawn about ₹3 lakh crore from Indian equities in 2026 amid global factors like higher bond yields and a strong dollar, prompting echoes from Samir Arora and Mohandas Pai who labeled it unfair and urged zero tax for competitiveness. Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman welcomes the debate ahead of the next budget, where the current 12.5% LTCG rate applies above ₹1.25 lakh annually, while domestic buyers cushion the market pressure.
items.summary_zh: 在 CNBC-TV18 访谈中，Enam Group 联合创始人班沙利主张取消对境外机构投资者的长期资本利得税，称其他国家并无如此做法。2026 年外国证券投资从印度股市撤出约 3 万亿卢比，叠加全球债息走高与美元走强；萨米尔·阿罗拉与莫汉达斯·派等人亦批评不公，呼吁零税率以提升竞争力。财长西塔拉曼表示欢迎在下一财年预算前讨论；现行长期资本利得税率为 12.5%，年收益逾 12.5 万卢比部分适用，国内买盘则在一定程度上缓冲抛压。
items.body_en:
Financiers Urge India to Scrap Capital Gains Tax on Foreign Investors.

Veteran financier Vallabh Bhanshali bluntly called India's capital gains tax on foreign investors a global outlier that's damaged inflows. As FPIs pull out billions, he's pushing for a full review.

In a CNBC-TV18 interview, Enam Group's co-founder Vallabh Bhanshali argued the long-term capital gains tax on foreign institutional investors should be eliminated, noting no other country imposes it this way.

FPIs have withdrawn about ₹3 lakh crore from Indian equities in 2026 amid global factors like higher bond yields and a strong dollar, prompting echoes from Samir Arora and Mohandas Pai who labeled it unfair and urged zero tax for competitiveness. Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman welcomes the debate ahead of the next budget, where the current 12.5% LTCG rate applies above ₹1.25 lakh annually, while domestic buyers cushion the market pressure.

2026 年外国证券投资从印度股市撤出约 3 万亿卢比，叠加全球债息走高与美元走强；萨米尔·阿罗拉与莫汉达斯·派等人亦批评不公，呼吁零税率以提升竞争力。财长西塔拉曼表示欢迎在下一财年预算前讨论；现行长期资本利得税率为 12.5%，年收益逾 12.5 万卢比部分适用，国内买盘则在一定程度上缓冲抛压。

他正在拍摄《Lizard Music》，这部真人与 CGI 结合的作品改编自丹尼尔·平克沃特 1976 年童书：男孩在深夜电视发现演奏异界音乐的蜥蜴，并结识鸡肉人及其 111 岁老母鸡。

items.title_en: Fans Defend Ariana Grande as Glinda Against Amanda Seyfried Casting Talk
items.title_zh: 粉丝力挺格兰德饰演格琳达，回应赛弗里德「本可更好」论
items.hook_en: A post wondering if Amanda Seyfried would have topped Ariana Grande as Glinda in Wicked quickly met pushback from fans who love the film's magic just as it is.
items.hook_zh: 有人猜测若由阿曼达·赛弗里德演《魔法坏女巫》格琳达会否更佳，粉丝迅速反驳：电影本身已够魔力。
items.summary_en: Ariana Grande shines as the bubbly Glinda opposite Cynthia Erivo's Elphaba in Jon M. Chu's hit musical films, which have pulled in hundreds of millions at the box office. Seyfried auditioned multiple times, even carving out time during The Dropout shoots, but later said Grande was meant for the role and called the movie fantastic. Fans highlight Grande's vocal range, her chemistry with Erivo, and director Chu's praise for her unique audition energy, shutting down the recurring what-if debate. The back-and-forth underscores fans' strong bond with Wicked's tale of friendship and ambition.
items.summary_zh: 爱莉安娜·格兰德在朱浩伟执导的音乐电影中饰演活泼的格琳达，与辛西娅·埃里沃的艾尔法巴对手戏，票房累计数亿美元。赛弗里德曾多次试镜，后称角色本就属于格兰德并盛赞影片。粉丝强调其音域、与埃里沃的化学反应以及导演对其试镜能量的肯定，终结反复出现的「假如」争论。

Fans Defend Ariana Grande as Glinda Against Amanda Seyfried Casting Talk.

A post wondering if Amanda Seyfried would have topped Ariana Grande as Glinda in Wicked quickly met pushback from fans who love the film's magic just as it is.

Ariana Grande shines as the bubbly Glinda opposite Cynthia Erivo's Elphaba in Jon M. Chu's hit musical films, which have pulled in hundreds of millions at the box office.

Seyfried auditioned multiple times, even carving out time during The Dropout shoots, but later said Grande was meant for the role and called the movie fantastic. Fans highlight Grande's vocal range, her chemistry with Erivo, and director Chu's praise for her unique audition energy, shutting down the recurring what-if debate. The back-and-forth underscores fans' strong bond with Wicked's tale of friendship and ambition.

items.hook_en: Jaafar Jackson, nephew of the King of Pop, steps into the spotlight with a Critics Choice honor for his feature debut as Michael Jackson.

items.summary_en: The Critics Choice Association named Jaafar Jackson the Actor Award – Film recipient at the 9th Annual Celebration of Black Cinema & Television for his portrayal in Lionsgate's 'Michael,' the first biopic to top $1 billion worldwide and Lionsgate's biggest release ever. Their warm responses highlight his growing, versatile draw.

Hudson Williams felt a wave of relief when fans cheered his leap from steamy hockey romance to supernatural thriller. Their excitement for 'Yaga' showed his appeal goes beyond one hit role.

The 25-year-old Canadian actor, known for Shane Hollander in 'Heated Rivalry,' stars in dual roles as Henry Park and Logan in the upcoming Crave and AMC+ series 'Yaga,' premiering October 23. The show reimagines Slavic folklore with Baba Yaga in a modern mystery thriller featuring desire, ancient magic, and leads like Carrie-Anne Moss and Noah Reid.

items.summary_en: Burberry launched a short film and portraits featuring Thai actor-singer Bright Vachirawit and South Korean footballer Son Heung-Min exploring Los Angeles' contrasting rhythms. Bright drives through California scenery in layered looks like navy wool peacoats and chunky check scarves, while Son relaxes in a black double-breasted coat during an early garden stroll. items.title_en: AI Predicts Cancer Survival from Face Photos

items.hook_en: Doctors have always glanced at a patient's face to sense how sick they might be. Now AI makes that gut feel precise, spotting survival odds from a single snapshot.
items.hook_zh: 医生一向会扫一眼患者面容判断病情轻重；如今 AI 把这种直觉量化，单张快照即可估计生存概率。
items.summary_en: Researchers from Mass General Brigham, Dana-Farber, Harvard, and Dutch partners unveiled FAHR-Face, two AI tools trained on millions of images that estimate biological age and forecast mortality risk for cancer patients. In tests with over 34,000 patients, the survival model showed those in the highest-risk group faced three times the death risk of the lowest, even after accounting for clinical factors, with strong results in an independent validation. While promising for low-cost checks using just a phone photo, the tools—mostly trained on white Boston patients—need more diverse testing and aren't ready for clinics yet. Lead researchers see it as a complement to doctor judgment, with the model now public on Hugging Face.

items.title_en: Biosphere 2 Experiment Revives Debates on Self-Sustaining Living

items.hook_en: Eight people stepped into a glass dome in the Arizona desert in 1991, aiming to create a sealed world with its own rainforest, ocean, and farm. Two years later, they emerged thinner but alive, sparking lessons that echo today.

items.title_en: Reuters Reveals Heat Storms Blanketing Earth for 18 Years Straight

items.hook_en: Imagine heat waves so massive they cover nearly 85% of the planet for over a year—Reuters' investigation uncovers this new reality reshaping daily life worldwide.

items.summary_en: Reuters analyzed over 600 billion temperature readings since 1960 and found heat storms—vast heat waves spanning at least 1% of Earth's surface—now strike 102 times a year on average, up from five in the 1960s. Since July 6, 2008, at least one has raged somewhere every single day, an unbroken 18-year cascade. People share struggles with the relentless heat, which kills nearly half a million annually and damages ecosystems, while the outlet launched a live tracker to monitor these events like hurricanes. Meteorologist Ryan Maue questions the framing, noting a shift in average temperatures explains much of the rise, but Reuters argues naming them helps the public grasp the scale.

items.hook_en: Cancer patients often share the same diagnosis but have wildly different tumor behaviors. SophontAI's new Holon-S1 changes that by unlocking molecular insights straight from everyday pathology slides.

items.hook_zh: 详细科学综述梳理逾 100 项实验室与动物研究，归纳两种药物在 25 种人类癌症中协同对抗癌细胞的 37 种方式。
items.summary_en: Researchers at the McCullough Foundation, including Nicolas Hulscher, Peter A. McCullough, and Harvey Risch, synthesized preclinical evidence showing the drugs disrupt cancer cell division, trigger cell death, block energy and blood vessel growth, and more. The 44-page paper notes their low cost, off-patent status, and long safety record in humans, with overlapping effects on key cancer processes. While calling for large clinical trials, it references limited human reports like a Polish woman's normalized markers after using the combo, though experts stress the need for randomized trials amid some study retractions.
items.summary_zh: McCullough 基金会 Nicolas Hulscher、Peter A. McCullough、Harvey Risch 等综合临床前证据，显示药物可干扰癌细胞分裂、诱导死亡、阻断能量与血管生成等。44 页论文强调其成本低、已过专利、人类长期用药安全记录，以及对关键癌症过程有重叠作用。作者呼吁大型临床试验，并提及波兰一病例用药后指标正常化等有限人体报告；专家仍强调需随机试验，且部分研究曾遭撤稿。
items.body_en:
Review Identifies 37 Anticancer Mechanisms for Ivermectin and Mebendazole Combo.

A detailed scientific review uncovers 37 ways ivermectin and mebendazole team up against cancer cells across 25 human types, drawing from over 100 lab and animal studies.

Researchers at the McCullough Foundation, including Nicolas Hulscher, Peter A. McCullough, and Harvey Risch, synthesized preclinical evidence showing the drugs disrupt cancer cell division, trigger cell death, block energy and blood vessel growth, and more.

The 44-page paper notes their low cost, off-patent status, and long safety record in humans, with overlapping effects on key cancer processes. While calling for large clinical trials, it references limited human reports like a Polish woman's normalized markers after using the combo, though experts stress the need for randomized trials amid some study retractions.
items.body_zh:
综述：伊维菌素与甲苯咪唑联用现 37 种抗癌机制。

详细科学综述梳理逾 100 项实验室与动物研究，归纳两种药物在 25 种人类癌症中协同对抗癌细胞的 37 种方式。

McCullough 基金会 Nicolas Hulscher、Peter A. McCullough、Harvey Risch 等综合临床前证据，显示药物可干扰癌细胞分裂、诱导死亡、阻断能量与血管生成等。44 页论文强调其成本低、已过专利、人类长期用药安全记录，以及对关键癌症过程有重叠作用。

作者呼吁大型临床试验，并提及波兰一病例用药后指标正常化等有限人体报告；专家仍强调需随机试验，且部分研究曾遭撤稿。

items.body_en:
Trump Signs Order for NIH Women’s Health Division and Task Force.

First Lady Melania Trump stood beside President Trump as he signed the executive order, calling it a transformative moment for women's health in America.

On October 19, President Donald Trump signed an executive order establishing a new Women’s Health Division at the National Institutes of Health and a White House task force co-led by Chief of Staff Susie Wiles and HHS Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr.

The initiative targets research gaps in conditions like osteoporosis, Alzheimer’s, heart disease, endometriosis, and maternal health, with the division to launch within 90 days. Melania Trump outlined five pillars for innovation, including AI-driven discoveries and affordable therapies, while Wiles shared how her breast cancer experience made early detection personal.

items.title_en: Electric Plant Launches Bombadil AI to Read Plant Electrical Signals
items.title_zh: Electric Plant 推出 Bombadil：解读植物电信号的 AI
items.hook_en: Imagine slipping a tiny sensor into a plant and getting a real-time readout of its health, just like monitoring brainwaves. Electric Plant's new AI, Bombadil, makes that possible by decoding subtle electrical signals from living plants.
items.hook_zh: 像监测脑电一样，把微型传感器接入植物即可实时读健康——Bombadil 解码活体植物微弱电信号。
items.summary_en: The startup pairs low-cost Bud sensors with Bombadil, a foundation model trained on over seven million hours of data from 125 plant species, to track stress, water needs, photosynthesis efficiency, and more. Co-founder Justin Mast says it could cut water use by 20 percent or more for growers by enabling precise irrigation based on individual plant signals rather than soil alone. Backed by an $11.2 million seed round, the team—from neuroscientists to AI experts—built it after years of recording signals in labs, forests, and orchards, with early enthusiasm for its potential in farming and climate tech.
items.summary_zh: 初创公司将低成本 Bud 传感器与在 125 种植物、逾 700 万小时数据上训练的基础模型 Bombadil 组合，追踪胁迫、需水、光合效率等。联合创始人 Justin Mast 称，按单株信号而非仅土壤精准灌溉，种植者用水或可降 20% 以上。种子轮 1120 万美元；团队含神经科学家与 AI 专家，经年在实验室、森林与果园记录信号，农业与气候科技前景获早期热捧。

The startup pairs low-cost Bud sensors with Bombadil, a foundation model trained on over seven million hours of data from 125 plant species, to track stress, water needs, photosynthesis efficiency, and more.

Co-founder Justin Mast says it could cut water use by 20 percent or more for growers by enabling precise irrigation based on individual plant signals rather than soil alone. Backed by an $11.2 million seed round, the team—from neuroscientists to AI experts—built it after years of recording signals in labs, forests, and orchards, with early enthusiasm for its potential in farming and climate tech.

items.title_en: Rocket Lab Videos Automated Machine Building Neutron Rocket Dome

items.hook_en: Thousands of hair-thin carbon fibers whip into place at blistering speeds, forming the massive forward dome for Neutron's Stage 1 tank. It's a glimpse into the precision powering Rocket Lab's next big leap.
items.hook_zh: 成千上万根发丝般碳纤维高速铺就 Neutron 一级贮箱巨大前穹顶。
items.summary_en: Rocket Lab released footage of its automated fiber placement machine at the Maryland facility laying down carbon strands up to 100 meters per minute on custom molds for the Neutron rocket's large composite forward dome. This step follows last week's news of a 2027 first-launch target after fixing voids in a prior manual dome, with CEO Peter Beck confirming refined processes and a successful aft dome. Investors and fans praised the update for building excitement around production progress toward a reusable rocket carrying 13,000 kg to orbit, with upcoming tests ahead.

items.title_en: Pakistan's First Comprehensive Stroke Centre Opens at JPMC in Karachi
items.title_zh: 巴基斯坦首家综合卒中中心在卡拉奇 JPMC 启用
items.hook_en: In Karachi, time-sensitive stroke care just got a major upgrade with Pakistan's first dedicated centre offering free, advanced treatment to anyone in need.
items.hook_zh: 卡拉奇时间敏感的卒中救治迎来升级：全国首家专项中心向有需要者提供免费、先进治疗。
items.summary_en: Jinnah Postgraduate Medical Centre in Karachi now runs the country's first comprehensive stroke centre, equipped with biplane angiography systems, a 15-bed neuro-ICU, step-down beds, and 24/7 CT scans for rapid stroke, aneurysm, and malformation treatment. Launched in 2026 through a partnership between the Pakistan Stroke Initiative, Patients’ Aid Foundation, JPMC, and the Sindh government, it provides all services free of cost after planning started around 2024, with early successes like aneurysm repairs and clot removals already saving lives. Supporters highlight how it eases family burdens in Sindh, where hundreds face strokes daily, building local expertise with international help to cut disability and deaths.

items.title_en: UN Report: 1.5°C Limit Overshoot Now Inevitable
items.title_zh: 联合国报告：暂时超越 1.5°C 已不可避免，但仍可逆转
items.hook_en: Years of slow action have closed the door on staying below 1.5°C warming without a temporary breach. The focus shifts to limiting how high and how long temperatures climb before dropping back.
items.hook_zh: 联合国传来沉重消息：数十年气候行动迟缓意味着将暂时突破 1.5°C 升温上限；但领导层称紧急行动仍可在本世纪末把温度拉回。
items.summary_en: The UN Environment Programme’s 2026 Emissions Gap Report states that global warming will exceed the Paris Agreement’s 1.5°C target in coming years, with the best-case peak at 1.7–1.8°C mid-century and a 50% chance of returning below 1.5°C by 2100. This requires emissions cuts of 18% by 2030, 45% by 2035, and 69% by 2040 from 2025 levels, plus large-scale carbon removal. Current pledges only achieve 5–8% cuts by 2030, heading toward 2.6°C or more warming. UNEP’s Inger Andersen calls for urgent action to minimize risks like floods and heatwaves ahead of COP31 talks.
items.summary_zh: 联合国环境规划署《2026 排放差距报告》警告，现行政策指向升温约 2.8°C，国家承诺可压至约 2.6°C。即便乐观路径，本世纪中叶仍见 1.7–1.8°C，之后才可能于 2100 年回到 1.5°C，需相对 2025 年水平在 2030 年减排 18%、2035 年 45%、2040 年 69%，并大规模碳移除。UNEP 负责人 Inger Andersen 与古特雷斯强调，要将「超标」幅度压到最小，必须立即全力以赴，在煤油气排放仍升之际依托可再生扩张。
items.body_en:
UN Report: 1.5°C Limit Overshoot Now Inevitable.

Years of slow action have closed the door on staying below 1.5°C warming without a temporary breach. The focus shifts to limiting how high and how long temperatures climb before dropping back.

The UN Environment Programme’s 2026 Emissions Gap Report states that global warming will exceed the Paris Agreement’s 1.5°C target in coming years, with the best-case peak at 1.7–1.8°C mid-century and a 50% chance of returning below 1.5°C by 2100. This requires emissions cuts of 18% by 2030, 45% by 2035, and 69% by 2040 from 2025 levels, plus large-scale carbon removal.

Current pledges only achieve 5–8% cuts by 2030, heading toward 2.6°C or more warming. UNEP’s Inger Andersen calls for urgent action to minimize risks like floods and heatwaves ahead of COP31 talks.

联合国报告：暂时超越 1.5°C 已不可避免，但仍可逆转。

联合国传来沉重消息：数十年气候行动迟缓意味着将暂时突破 1.5°C 升温上限；但领导层称紧急行动仍可在本世纪末把温度拉回。

联合国环境规划署《2026 排放差距报告》警告，现行政策指向升温约 2.8°C，国家承诺可压至约 2.6°C。即便乐观路径，本世纪中叶仍见 1.7–1.8°C，之后才可能于 2100 年回到 1.5°C，需相对 2025 年水平在 2030 年减排 18%、2035 年 45%、2040 年 69%，并大规模碳移除。

UNEP 负责人 Inger Andersen 与古特雷斯强调，要将「超标」幅度压到最小，必须立即全力以赴，在煤油气排放仍升之际依托可再生扩张。

Dr. Priti Adani Outlines National Expansion of Healthcare Education and Research.

At the Adani Institute's 17th convocation in Wardha, Dr. Priti Adani spoke directly to graduates about blending compassion with cutting-edge care.

Dr. Priti Adani, Chancellor of the Adani Institute of Higher Education and Research, announced plans to strengthen Wardha and Nagpur campuses with modern medical equipment, advanced research, and super-specialty services over the next two years.

The institute aims to build additional campuses across India, tailored to regional needs while upholding consistent standards and the principle of 'Seva hi sadhana hai'—service as devotion. Guided by UN Sustainable Development Goals, efforts will focus on preventive care, disease prevention, affordable treatments, and support for disadvantaged students, with Dr. Adani urging graduates to prioritize patients' dignity and lifelong learning alongside technical skills.
